depth_justification: Early turns engage MediCall specifics (Google Cloud Translate cross-border transfer, DEP/DMP pull, reacting to the 'no AI in clinical pathway' disclosure), but it then repeats Reflection Questions 16-19 and the summary table verbatim three times, leans on repeatedly wrong citations (GDPR Art. 30 for access control, Art. 85 for data ownership, MDR Art. 13(1) for data integrity), and the final report even invents an 'AI-driven consultations' risk the user explicitly ruled out.
actionability_justification: Mitigations name some implementable controls (RBAC, encryption at rest/in transit, audit logs, ISO 27001, DPAs/SCCs with Google Cloud) but stay largely directional ('appoint a DPO', 'ensure transparency', 'conduct risk assessments') without concrete configurations or artifacts.
